# Closh African Cow Bell

\\nThe closh is an African bell made from metal. It has a very bright high pitched sound and is usually struck with a metal rod, coin, or ring. It is often played with the [three dunduns](/product/dununs/), the kenkenni, sangban and dundunba. The three different sizes match the three different sizes of the dundun drums and give a high pitched melody to complement the bass melody of the dunduns
